Before you fly ✈️

The boring-but-important bits

Read once, forget forever. (You've got a 5-year-old to keep alive; I've got the logistics.)

🛂

Visa

UAE passport = visa-free 🎉
Kuwait / Oman / Bahrain need one. Keep 6+ months on the passport.
💵

Money

South African Rand · R100 ≈ $5
Bring US dollars and swap them at the airport. Cards work almost everywhere.
📶

Internet

Vodacom Tourist SIM
Grab one at arrivals — far cheaper than roaming. 20+20GB ≈ R599.
🔌

Plugs

Type-M (3 fat round pins)
The weirdest plug you'll ever meet. Pack a universal adapter — trust me.
🕐

Time

2 hours behind the UAE
Basically no jet lag. Alyaz will be bouncing by breakfast.
❄️

Weather

July = SA winter, ~10–18°C
Cool & cozy. Pack warm layers + a light rain jacket. Bonus: whale season, no crowds.
✈️

The flight

~10 hrs · Dubai → Cape Town (CPT)
An overnight flight = a sleeping child = a happy mama.
🚗

Getting around

Rent a car at the airport
They drive on the LEFT here. Book a trusted counter; car seat for Alyaz.
Where you sleep · Nights 1–3

🏖️ Base One — Camps Bay

Everything below is a short hop from your pillow. Organized by home base, so you're never zig-zagging with a tired 5-year-old.

🏨 The Marly Boutique Hotel & Spa Nights 1–3
The beachy, glam one

Camps Bay — Cape Town's little Miami

Palm trees, a golden beach, and the Twelve Apostles mountains photobombing every single sunset. This is your "wake up, breathe the ocean, feel fancy" base.

✨
The Marly: a 5-star boutique right on the beach strip — rooftop pool with 360° ocean views, a spa for Mama, and a sunset pool-bar that Alyaz will think is a treasure island.
🗺️ Do this
Free🧒 Kiddo-approved

Camps Bay sunset strip

Right outside the hotel: palm-lined sand and the kind of sunset that makes grown-ups gasp. Ice cream mandatory.

Free0 min · downstairs
🐚 Alyaz mission: find the prettiest shell.
📅 Clear day🧒 Kiddo-approved

Table Mountain Cableway

A rotating cable car floats you up one of the New7Wonders of Nature. Go on a still, clear morning — the mountain "closes" when it's windy.

R450 ≈ $23 adultR225 child~15 min
☁️ Look for the "tablecloth" cloud on top!
🧒 Kiddo-approved📸 Photo-op

Boulders Beach penguins

Hundreds of tiny tuxedoed African penguins waddling an arm's length away on a boardwalk. Peak Alyaz joy, basically guaranteed.

R176 ≈ $9 adultR88 child~40 min
🐧 They honk like little donkeys — listen!
⛰️ Scenic🧒 Kiddo-approved

Cape Point & Cape of Good Hope

The dramatic southern tip of Africa — lighthouse, wild ocean, cheeky baboons. Pair it with the penguins for one big peninsula day.

~R400 ≈ $20 park~1.5 hr drive
🐒 Baboon rule: look, laugh, never feed.
⛰️ Scenic drive

Chapman's Peak Drive

114 curves of jaw-dropping cliff road hugging the ocean. It's the *journey* — do it on the way to the peninsula.

~R60 tollen route
Almost free🧒 Kiddo-approved📸 Photo-op

Bo-Kaap rainbow streets

Cobbled lanes of hot-pink, lime and turquoise houses. A storybook come to life and the best photos of the whole trip.

Free to wander~15 min
🌈 Alyaz game: name every colour you see.
🧒 Kiddo-approved🌿 Gardens

Kirstenbosch Gardens

Lush botanical gardens with a treetop "Boomslang" canopy walk. Room to run, picnic, and let little legs go wild.

~R120 ≈ $6~20 min
Free⛰️ Scenic hike

Lion's Head hike

An easy-ish spiral trail with 360° views over the city, sea and Table Mountain. Golden at sunrise, magic on a full-moon night.

Free~15 min drive
🌅 Little legs? Go partway for the big view.
Free🧒 Kiddo-approved

Saunders Rock sunset

A tucked-away tidal pool and beach near Sea Point — calmer than the main strip and a dreamy spot for the evening light.

Free~10 min
🌊 Safe little pool for a paddle.
🧒 Pony option🐴 Bucket-list

Noordhoek beach horse ride

The famous Dunes Beach Ride along an endless white beach. Ask about a led pony for Alyaz while Mama takes the bigger horse.

~R650+ ≈ $33~40 min drive
🐴 A real horse on a real beach!
🎢 Grown-up thrill

Sky, sea & dunes

For the adrenaline crew: tandem paragliding off Signal Hill, sea kayaking past seals, or a quad-bike blast on the Atlantic dunes.

from ~R700 ≈ $35half-day
🎢 Grown-up thrill

Cape Sidecar tour

Ride Chapman's Peak in a vintage sidecar with a private driver — or self-drive a classic Cobra (Cobra Experience). Ridiculously cool, but really a Mama-and-friends treat.

R2,600 ≈ $130 pp~2 hrs
🎢 Older kids +

Sandboarding the dunes

Snowboarding… on sand. A blast for big kids and grown-ups on the Atlantis dunes. Park Alyaz-approved activities for another day.

R995 ≈ $50 pp~2.5 hrs
🍽️ Eat here

GOLD Restaurant ★4.6

Pan-African feast + drums

A dish from a different African country each course, with live drumming & puppets. A 2–3 hr show-dinner. Arrive ~6:30. Book ahead.

Arlecchino by Tashas

Italian · stylish

Chic, easy, kid-friendly plates of pasta and pizza after a big beach day.

Bukhara

Indian · booking

Cape Town's iconic Indian. Rich, warm, wonderful. Reserve a table.

Persian Peacock

Persian · booking

Lavish Persian feasting in a beautiful room. A proper sit-down dinner — reserve ahead.

Belmond Mount Nelson

High tea · iconic

The legendary pink hotel's afternoon tea — tiny cakes, big elegance. Alyaz will feel very grown-up.

Jarryds / Pauline's

Brunch · Sea Point

Pretty breakfasts and great coffee to fuel a big day out.

Coffee crawl ☕

Cape Town runs on it

Beyond Truth: Jarryds, Strangers Club, Coco Safar & Our Local. Flat white for Mama, babyccino for Alyaz.

Truth Coffee

Café · steampunk

A world-famous roastery dressed like a Jules Verne machine. Coffee for Mama, hot chocolate for Alyaz.

The Peckish Penguin

Casual · Simon's Town

Lunch stop right by the penguins. Cheerful and family-easy.

Pizza Shed / Brash Burgers

Casual · fun

The "everyone's tired, just feed the child" heroes. Genuinely good too.

  • Do the whole peninsula (penguins → Cape Point → Chapman's Peak) as one loop day — it's all south of you.
  • Table Mountain is weather's plaything: keep it flexible and grab the first clear, calm morning.
  • Book GOLD the moment you land — it fills up, and it's a highlight.
  • Weekend mornings: swing by The Old Biscuit Mill market (Woodstock) for global food stalls.
Where you sleep · Night 4

🦁 Base Two — The Safari

The one night the whole trip is secretly built around. Already booked and waiting for you.

🌾 Big Five game reserve Night 4
The magic one

Out where the wild things really are

Trade the ocean for golden grass and acacia trees. This is the day Alyaz points at a real elephant and forgets how to breathe for a second. A couple of hours from the city, a whole world away.

🔥
The night: arrive for an afternoon game drive, dinner under a sky stuffed with stars, a crackling fire, then a cozy lodge — and a sunrise drive before you roll home.
🗺️ What happens
Included🧒 Kiddo-approved

Evening game drive

Bounce into the bush in an open jeep as the light turns gold. Lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras — eyes peeled.

Includedon arrival
🦁 The Big Five hunt begins!
Included

Sundowners & the boma fire

Drinks as the sun drops, then dinner around the fire with the sounds of the wild as your soundtrack.

Included
🧒 Kiddo-approved

Stargazing

No city lights = the biggest sky Alyaz has ever seen. Spot the Southern Cross and make a wish.

Freeafter dinner
⭐ Count the shooting stars.
Included🧒 Early start

Sunrise game drive

The best animal show is at dawn. Wrap up warm — winter mornings in an open jeep are chilly but unforgettable.

Includednext morning
🦒 Giraffes for breakfast, anyone?
  • Dress WARM for the dawn drive — hats, layers, a blanket for Alyaz. It's cold before the sun's up.
  • Closed shoes, a little pair of binoculars, and a camera with room to spare.
  • Let the ranger lead — quiet voices, and the animals come closer.
  • This is a "just be here" day. No schedule, all wonder.
Where you sleep · Nights 5–7

🎡 Base Three — V&A Waterfront

The polished, walkable finale. Restaurants, shopping and attractions all on your doorstep — easy mode with a little one.

🛍️ On the harbor Nights 5–7
The easy, sparkly one

V&A Waterfront — everything, on your doorstep

Cape Town's safe, buzzy harbor: luxury shops, a big wheel, boats and buskers. After a week of adventures, this is where you slow down, shop, and let Alyaz run out her last drops of energy. (Great hotels here: Table Bay, The Westin, Radisson RED, The Onyx.)

🚶‍♀️
Why here: you can stroll to dinner, the wheel, the market and the shops — no car, no stress, no melt-downs.
🗺️ Do this
🧒 Kiddo-approved🌅 Sunset

A gentle giant Ferris wheel with dreamy views over the harbor and Table Mountain. Time it for sunset.

From your travel fairy 🧚

A few honest whispers

📌 Book these early

GOLD Restaurant, the helicopter, and Bukhara / Nobu fill up fast. Reserve as soon as dates are set.

🌦️ Keep the mountain flexible

Table Mountain & Cape Point depend on wind & cloud. Slot them for your first clear, calm day — don't force them.

🧭 Save these for next time

Garden Route treats — Mossel Bay zipline, Cool Runnings toboggan, Bloukrans bungee — are 5–6 hrs east. Not this trip; a perfect excuse to come back.

🐋 Hermanus is doable

Whale-watching near Hermanus is only ~1.5–2 hrs — a great day trip, and July is peak season.

🧥 Pack for winter

Warm layers, a light rain jacket, comfy shoes, and something toasty for the dawn safari drive.

🧒 Alyaz's greatest hits

Penguins, cable car, Cape Wheel, aquarium, safari animals. Skip the sandboarding & bungee — those are for the big kids.

Ten days, three beds, and a little girl who'll come home talking about penguins and lions forever.

Have the best trip, Hoor & Alyaz. ♥
